# Kingdom Hearts Dream Drop Distance Archipelago 0.0.6

*This version has **breaking** changes. Please do not update to this version if you have a run ongoing.*
### APWorld Changes
- Fixed several logic issues in Traverse Town
- Made socket non-blocking for better Linux compatibility
- Defeating Ansem II now awards 3 checks (one for each boss in the gauntlet)

### AP Companion Changes
- New AP Item Icon (Thanks Halrondo!)
***NEW QOL***
- Added a Report that details your Go Mode conditions and whether you have achieved them (can be found in Reports -> Glossaries)
- All save points in a world will unlock after clearing that world
- Available Flowmotion is now accurately reflected in action command inventory
- A world item for TT2 now appears in inventory when it's accessible
- Active Spirits are now affected by the EXP Multiplier
- Spirit Rank now randomized when auto-crafting
- Obtained Exp now restored after death
*** BUG FIXES***
- Reworked some under-the-hood stuff for stability and performance (this involves making certain checks much less frequent, so please report if you encounter any oddities!)
- Reworked EXP Multiplier to prevent early level up checks
- Removed purgatory (maybe finally?)
- Flick Rush option no longer sends the player to Traverse Town
- Fixed a bug where certain rooms became inaccessible
- Fixed a bug where action commands could not be equipped
- Fixed an issue where spirits sent several level up prompts
- Other minor fixes
